notes: Bonobos' two San Francisco Guideshops, named in issue #318, read from each store page on 2026-09-12. https://bonobos.com/locations links 47 store pages and two of them are in the city; each store page carries no schema.org LocalBusiness block, so the address and hours come from the Contentful blocks the page server-renders into its __NEXT_DATA__, which is what the visible page prints. Four fetches of both pages on 2026-09-11 and 2026-09-12 were identical. `name` is the brand, `name_as_listed` the page's own heading for the shop. A Guideshop is a fitting room rather than a stockroom — you try on and the order ships — but it is the business trading from the door, so it goes on the page as one. The issue gives the referral link and '25% off'; neither the link's landing page nor a public Bonobos page states the friend's discount, so the offer wording is the issue's, which is where a referral offer has to come from: only a person can join the programme. One link covers both shops — it opens Bonobos' own refer-a-friend page — so there is one REFERRALS row, `bonobos`, and one source id for both pages.

coverage.remaining: None; both San Francisco Guideshops are here. The other 45 stores are outside the city.
